title: TokenRequest
description: Request body for creating an OAuth2 access token.

grant_type.description: OAuth2 grant type. Use "client_credentials" for server-side integrations.

client_id.description: The Moov API key public identifier.

scope.description: Space-separated list of permission scopes to request. Scopes follow the pattern /accounts/{accountID}/transfers.write for resource-specific access, or /accounts.write for platform-level access.
